# Galaxy UDT Templates And Troubleshooting

Read only the section needed for the current UDT.

## Minimal UDT

Replace the container placeholder with a pinned BioContainer found through one
bounded live BioContainers lookup. Use a bare tagged reference without
`docker://` or a digest.

```yaml
class: GalaxyUserTool
id: analysis-v1
name: Analysis
version: 0.1.0
container: quay.io/biocontainers/<package>:<pinned-tag>

shell_command: |
  set -eu
  selected-command \
    --input "$(inputs.input.path)" \
    --output result.tsv

inputs:
  - name: input
    type: data
    format: [tabular]

outputs:
  - name: result
    type: data
    format: tabular
    from_work_dir: result.tsv
```

For generated glue scripts, avoid nested `python -c` quoting. A base64 argument
keeps the script as one shell token:

```bash
SCRIPT_B64='BASE64_WITHOUT_NEWLINES'
python -c 'import base64, pathlib, sys; pathlib.Path("job.py").write_bytes(base64.b64decode(sys.argv[1]))' "$SCRIPT_B64"
python job.py "$(inputs.inpu

representation.name: Extract PA14_35160 DESeq2 result metadata
representation.shell_command:
set -eu
cat > extract.R <<'RSCRIPT'
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(DESeq2))
args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly = TRUE)
paths <- args[1:2]
labels <- args[3:4]
gene <- args[5]
out <- args[6]
collapse_field <- function(x) {
  if (length(x) == 0 || is.null(x)) return("")
  x <- paste(as.character(x), collapse = "; ")
  gsub("[\t\r\n]+", " | ", x)
}
one <- function(path, label) {
  obj <- readRDS(path)
  if (!(gene %in% rownames(obj))) stop(paste("missing gene", gene, "in", label))
  tab <- as.data.frame(obj)
  row <- tab[gene, , drop = FALSE]
  descriptions <- ""
  if ("description" %in% names(S4Vectors::mcols(obj))) {
    descriptions <- paste(S4Vectors::mcols(obj)$description, collapse = " || ")
  }
  meta_lines <- capture.output(str(S4Vectors::metadata(obj), max.level = 3))
  data.frame(
    file = label,
    class = paste(class(obj), collapse = ";"),
    metadata_names = collapse_field(names(S4Vectors::metadata(obj))),
    metadata_str = collapse_field(meta_lines),
    mcols_descriptions = collapse_field(descriptions),
    rowname = gene,
    baseMean = row$baseMean,
    log2FoldChange = row$log2FoldChange,
    lfcSE = row$lfcSE,
    stat = row$stat,
    pvalue = row$pvalue,
    padj = row$padj,
    check.names = FALSE
  )
}
res <- do.call(rbind, Map(one, paths, labels))
write.table(res, file = out, sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE, na = "NA")
RSCRIPT

events.command:
set -eu
cat > extract.R <<'RSCRIPT'
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(DESeq2))
args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly = TRUE)
paths <- args[1:2]
labels <- args[3:4]
gene <- args[5]
out <- args[6]
collapse_field <- function(x) {
  if (length(x) == 0 || is.null(x)) return("")
  x <- paste(as.character(x), collapse = "; ")
  gsub("[\t\r\n]+", " | ", x)
}
one <- function(path, label) {
  obj <- readRDS(path)
  if (!(gene %in% rownames(obj))) stop(paste("missing gene", gene, "in", label))
  tab <- as.data.frame(obj)
  row <- tab[gene, , drop = FALSE]
  descriptions <- ""
  if ("description" %in% names(S4Vectors::mcols(obj))) {
    descriptions <- paste(S4Vectors::mcols(obj)$description, collapse = " || ")
  }
  meta_lines <- capture.output(str(S4Vectors::metadata(obj), max.level = 3))
  data.frame(
    file = label,
    class = paste(class(obj), collapse = ";"),
    metadata_names = collapse_field(names(S4Vectors::metadata(obj))),
    metadata_str = collapse_field(meta_lines),
    mcols_descriptions = collapse_field(descriptions),
    rowname = gene,
    baseMean = row$baseMean,
    log2FoldChange = row$log2FoldChange,
    lfcSE = row$lfcSE,
    stat = row$stat,
    pvalue = row$pvalue,
    padj = row$padj,
    check.names = FALSE
  )
}
res <- do.call(rbind, Map(one, paths, labels))
write.table(res, file = out, sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE, na = "NA")
RSCRIPT

    def copy_history(self, history_id: str, name: str | None = None, all_datasets: bool = False) -> dict[str, Any]:
        """
        Create a new history by copying an existing one.

        :type history_id: str
        :param history_id: ID of the history to copy.

        :type name: str
        :param name: Optional name for new history

        :type all_datasets: bool
        :param all_datasets: Whether to copy also deleted datasets and dataset collections.

        :rtype: dict
        :return: Dictionary containing information about the newly created history
        """
        payload: dict[str, Any] = {"source": "history"}
        if name is not None:

        payload["history_id"] = history_id
        if all_datasets:

  set -eu

    --output result.tsv

inputs:

    type: data
    format: [tabular]

outputs:

## Minimal UDT

Replace the container placeholder with a pinned BioContainer found through one
bounded live BioContainers lookup. Use a bare tagged reference without

class: GalaxyUserTool
id: analysis-v1

  set -eu

inputs:

    from_work_dir: result.tsv
```

# Copy datasets from seed to working history
SEED="bbd44e69cb8906b59df98902ce5f37e2"
WORK="bbd44e69cb8906b518769938bde7e0fb"

# Get dataset IDs from seed
datasets=$(curl -s -H "x-api-key: [REDACTED_GALAXY_API_KEY]" "https://usegalaxy.org/api/histories/$SEED/contents" | python3 -c "
import sys,json
contents = json.load(sys.stdin)
for item in contents:
    print(item['id'], item['name'], item['history_content_type'])
")

echo "$datasets"

# Copy each dataset
echo "$datasets" | while read -r ds_id ds_name ds_type; do
    echo "Copying $ds_name ($ds_id)..."
    result=$(curl -s -X POST -H "x-api-key: [REDACTED_GALAXY_API_KEY]" \
        "https://usegalaxy.org/api/histories/$WORK/contents/datasets" \
        -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
        -d "{\"source\":\"hda\",\"content\":\"$ds_id\"}")
    echo "$result" | python3 -c "import sys,json; r=json.load(sys.stdin); print('New ID:', r.get('id','error'), r.get('name',''))" 2>/dev/null || echo "Copy attempted"
done

# Now download the CSV file from the new history

        dataset_id = item['id']

        print("CSV downloaded successfully")
    elif item['name'].endswith('.rds'):
        print(f"RDS dataset: {item['name']} ID: {item['id']}")

x97 <- readRDS("/workspace/inputs/res_1vs97.rds")
x98 <- readRDS("/workspace/inputs/res_1vs98.rds")

# Check other phenazine genes from the CSV
# First, find all phenazine-related genes
cat("Looking for phenazine genes in both comparisons...\n")

# Known phenazine genes in PA14
phz_genes <- c("PA14_35160", "PA14_09400", "PA14_09410", "PA14_09420", 
               "PA14_09430", "PA14_09440", "PA14_09450", "PA14_09460",
               "PA14_09470", "PA14_09480", "PA14_09490", "PA14_09500",
               "PA14_09510", "PA14_09900", "PA14_39940", "PA14_39950")

# Get phenazine related genes from CSV
con <- file("/workspace/inputs/Pseudomonas_aeruginosa_UCBPP-PA14.csv", "r")
lines <- readLines(con)
close(con)
phz_lines <- grep("phenazine", lines, ignore.case=TRUE, value=TRUE)
cat("Phenazine-related genes in CSV:\n")
for(l in phz_lines) {
  parts <- strsplit(l, ",")[[1]]
  cat("  ", parts[6], ": ", parts[11], "\n", sep="")
}

# Now check what happens to these genes in both comparisons
cat("\n=== Phenazine gene log2FC ===\n")
cat(sprintf("%-15s %12s %12s\n", "Gene", "res_1vs97", "res_1vs98"))
cat(strrep("-", 42), "\n")
for(name in c("res_1vs97", "res_1vs98")) {
  # NA
}

a97 <- attributes(x97)
a98 <- attributes(x98)
rn97 <- a97$rownames
rn98 <- a98$rownames
ld97 <- a97$listData
ld98 <- a98$listData

# Get all phenazine locus tags
phz_tags <- character(0)
for(l in phz_lines) {
  parts <- strsplit(l, ",")[[1]]
  phz_tags <- c(phz_tags, parts[6])
}
phz_tags <- unique(phz_tags)

for(tag in phz_tags) {
  idx97 <- which(rn97 == tag)
  idx98 <- which(rn98 == tag)
  fc97 <- if(length(idx97) > 0) round(ld97$log2FoldChange[idx97], 3) else NA
  fc98 <- if(length(idx98) > 0) round(ld98$log2FoldChange[idx98], 3) else NA
  cat(sprintf("%-15s %12s %12s\n", tag, fc97, fc98))
}
' 2>&1
